Add your email domain, prove it with a DNS record and send the values below to your IT team. OpenGrants then connects your identity provider.
settingsSecurity.name: Name
settingsSecurity.onlyActiveDomainsAre: Only active domains are required. Members with other addresses, API clients and connected agents are not affected.
settingsSecurity.proveTheDomainIs: Prove the domain is yours: add this TXT record at your DNS host, then check it. A record with the same value on the domain itself also works.
settingsSecurity.requireSingleSignOn2: Require single sign-on for people with these email addresses
settingsSecurity.setUpOpengrantsGms: Set up OpenGrants GMS as a SAML 2.0 application in your identity provider with these values.
settingsSecurity.sp.fileTitle: Single sign-on (SAML 2.0) for {workspace} on OpenGrants GMS
settingsSecurity.sp.sendEmail: Send the user's email address in the assertion (an email attribute, or the NameID).
settingsSecurity.thePartOfYour: The part of your staff's addresses after the @, like example.org.
settingsSecurity.theServerHasNo: The server has no Supabase address set, so these values cannot be shown.
settingsSecurity.theyMustSignIn: They must sign in through your identity provider to open this workspace.
settingsSecurity.youAreSignedIn: You are signed in with single sign-on.
settingsSecurity.youAreSignedIn2: You are signed in with an email code.
shareToGallery.emailAddressesPhoneNumber: Email addresses, phone numbers and web addresses other than your own site are removed. These names become “{placeholder}”:
shareToGallery.iAgreeToShare: I agree to share it under <link>{name}</link>: anyone may use and change it, with credit to {name2}.
shareToGallery.nothingIsPublicUntil: Nothing is public until it is approved. You will see the decision, and the reason if it is declined, under Forms, in “Shared to the gallery”.
shareToGallery.seeExactlyWhatWill: See exactly what will be shared
shareToGallery.separateWithCommasA: Separate with commas: a program's name, a person's name, a town.
shareToGallery.theGalleryGetsA: The gallery gets a copy of this {kind, select, application_form {application form} report_form {report form} rubric {rubric} email_template {email template} other {program kit}} (version {version}), not a link: your own stays as it is, and later edits are not shared.
shareToGallery.twoOrThreeSentences: Two or three sentences: what it is for, and who it suits.
shareToGallery.youCanWithdrawIt: You can withdraw it at any time, before or after it is published.
